title: Blink vs Base44: Full-Stack App Builder vs Internal Tool Builder
summary: Blink vs Base44 compared: database, auth, hosting, pricing, and use cases. Which AI app builder is right for you in 2026?
body_markdown: Superagents are Base44's autonomous AI agents. They connect to your external tools (Gmail, Slack, Calendar, CRMs) and can run workflows automatically — not just inside Base44, but across your existing software stack. It's a strong feature for internal ops automation. **[Blink](https://blink.new/)** focuses more on building the product itself, with AI powering the build session rather than autonomous post-build automation.
